$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 58 (acceptance-criteria templates). Declared before the work. The load-bearing condition is the second suite entry: an EMPTY criteria list must keep reading NO_CRITERIA_DECLARED and must never report satisfied by vacuous quantification. A template that silently satisfies itself would turn the completion firewall into a rubber stamp on first contact, so that check is mutation-tested and its mutation is recorded in the pull request rather than asserted here.
